name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Manchester Summer Programs
operator_name: Boys & Girls Clubs of Greater Manchester
description_short: Weekday summer day programs for kids entering grades K-12, run from the Union Street Clubhouse in Manchester. Programs include Kidz Kamp (K-1), Camp Foster on 20 acres in Bedford (grades 2-7), a Tween/Teen full-day program, a Tween/Teen drop-in program, and a STEM Launch Lab with SNHU (grades 5-8).
refund_policy_summary: The membership fee is not refundable. To cancel a week, email the Front Desk at least two weeks before it starts; a $10 per week per child fee applies. Later requests get no refund or transfer. A $25 deposit holds each week not paid in full.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp Foster's day includes swimming, open swim, boating and canoeing. Kidz Kamp visits Camp Foster once a week for swimming and pool activities. The camp's pages don't describe swim tests or lifeguarding.

warnings: This page shows the 2026 season, and that summer is over (today is 2026-10-13). There is no 2027 information yet, so dates and prices may change.
I calculated session end dates as 10 or 5 Monday-Friday weeks from the stated start dates. The page does not give end dates or say whether any holiday weeks are skipped.
Programs are booked by the week at $225/week ($325/week for STEM Launch Lab). The page gives no total price for a full session, so session prices are left blank.

The programs use more than one location: the Union Street Clubhouse (Manchester), Camp Foster (36 Camp Allen Road, Bedford, NH 03110) and the SNHU campus for STEM Launch Lab. Camp Foster campers check in and are picked up at the Union Street Clubhouse.
The Tween/Teen Drop-in program (grades 6-12, 12:00-6:00 PM) has no weekly fee, just a $10 annual membership. It is not listed as a session.
Kidz Kamp campers must be at least 4 years 9 months old by June 22. There is no overall minimum age in years.
